payload.summary: PRD APPROVED BY JIM (chat, 2026-08-01): 'Nothing seriously illogical. I would approve it.' Three implementation-risk notes ruled in with the approval, being folded into the PRD as explicit ACs: (1) F6 migration journals the complete selected set (incl. excluded near-misses with reasons) BEFORE creating any node — auditable coverage; (2) F7 resolve/distill and F10 archival are multi-record sequences riding the existing write-ahead choke point with validate --repair convergence from any interruption, crash-shaped ACs; (3) released = closed delta doctrine — new work on a released feature is a NEW node + NEW PRD (predecessor lineage link allowed), archived PRDs never reopened. Next: codex verify of the three edits, then epic decomposition and slice 1 build.
